summary: Session 62 verification (frontend only). CONFIRMED: the legacy HomeSavingsInquirySection is truly gone from the DOM on / — document.querySelector('[data-testid="home-savings-inquiry"]') === null, getElementById('home-savings-inquiry') === null, 0 occurrences of 'Anfrage · Vertraulich & unverbindlich', and document.body.innerHTML does NOT contain the string 'Anlageart' anywhere. HomeInvestmentSpectrum renders exactly 6 product cards (Aktienanlage, Festverzinsliche Wertpapiere, Fonds- und ETF-Anlage, Tagesgeld, Festgeld, Flexgeld) and each 'Fragen beantworten' CTA opens the Wizard with the correct product key: card0->'Aktien', card1->'Anleihen', card2->'Fonds / ETFs', card3->'Tagesgeld', card4->'Festgeld', card5->'Flexgeld'. All 6 wizards show '6 kurze Fragen zu Ihrer Anlage', progress 1/7 (6 questions + contact step), NO product-selection step and NO 'Anlageart' text in the dialog. Fonds starts with 'Was ist Ihr Hauptziel mit Fonds oder ETFs?'; tagesgeld/festgeld/flexgeld/aktien/anleihen all start with 'Wie hoch ist Ihr geplantes Anlagevolumen?'. Zero pageerrors on /, and no new React errors. Routes /handeln, /wissen, /fonds-grundlagen: 200, h1=1, zero pageerrors. TWO FAILURES: (1) HOME_SAVINGS_INQUIRY_ID was NOT updated — /app/frontend/src/data/homeSavingsFaq.js:15 still reads 'home-savings-inquiry', so the FAQ 'Frage stellen' CTA is now a silent no-op (scrollY 7519 -> 7519, delta 0; spectrum still 3216px away). No JS error (getElementById is null-guarded) but the CTA does nothing. (2) Supabase CHECK constraint still not widened: direct REST probe gives aktien 201 while fonds/tagesgeld/festgeld/flexgeld -> 400 {"code":"23514"} — pre-existing, not a Session 62 regression.
